properties.title: Distance to Upstream drainage line
properties.description:
Distance to upstream drainage line map for India built by [ACT4D](http://act4d.iitd.ernet.in/) research group at [IIT Delhi](https://home.iitd.ac.in/). Spatial indexing technique (e.g. k-d tree) is applied on pixel level digital elevation data (SRTM DEM) to compute the distance of each non-drainage pixel to its nearest upstream drainage line. 
Details of methodology can be found in the [technical manual](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZxovdpPThkN09cB1TcUYSE2BImI7M3k_/view) and the codebase on github.
